title: qSOFA
purpose: Rapid bedside flag for sepsis-related deterioration — no labs needed.

interpretation.label: Low — qSOFA < 2
interpretation.detail: Does not rule out sepsis; keep monitoring if clinical concern persists.

interpretation.label: High risk — qSOFA ≥ 2
interpretation.risk: Higher in-hospital mortality; assess for organ dysfunction, escalate care

notes: qSOFA is a prognostic prompt, not a sepsis diagnosis or a screening tool to withhold treatment. Surviving Sepsis 2021 recommends against using qSOFA as the single screening tool.
